response.original_title: STAR WARS: Revenge of the Sith Ultimate Edition Part II
response.overview: Darth Sidious commands clones to execute Order 66. Darth Vader takes the first steps in establishing the new Galactic Empire. Meanwhile, Ahsoka battles to survive, and Clone Force 99 adapts to a changing galaxy. This is the second part of a fan edit by Jedi's Knowledge that includes Revenge of the Sith with four (generally accepted as canon) deleted scenes, the final The Clone Wars arc, the first episode of The Bad Batch, Tales of the Jedi S1:E5, a scene from Tales of the Empire S1:E4, a scene from Tales of the Jedi S1:E6
response.title: STAR WARS: Revenge of the Sith Ultimate Edition Part II
